model.description: Tower Three presents Florida Freeze, a premium 3.5g flower offering that delivers a refreshing cannabis experience. This carefully cultivated bud showcases frosty trichomes and a vibrant appearance that lives up to its chilly name. The aroma profile bursts with citrus and tropical notes, complemented by sweet undertones that entice the senses. Each nug is hand-selected to ensure quality and potency, making this flower ideal for discerning consumers seeking authentic cannabis enjoyment. Whether you're looking to unwind after a long day or enhance your creative pursuits, Florida Freeze provides a smooth, flavorful smoke that captures the essence of quality craftsmanship. This 3.5g jar offers the perfect amount for exploring this unique strain's characteristics and discovering your favorite consumption method.
